commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: Blue cords return here. The keeper tied them herself before the rain.

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: Then I will note that she confirmed it. I will not mend the original handwriting into ours.

commands.speaker: dr_carrier
commands.text: I thought I had forgotten the way.

commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: The line got wet. You did not do anything wrong.
The cord lies beside the note, an ordinary small thing that helped an answer become clear.
